behavior.fixed_capture_scans: Reject the complete requested range scan grid or bookmark list before any scan tune or measurement if a nominal channel cannot fit in the file. The error identifies the unavailable frequency and usable VFO interval. The scan disables and clears pending tuning/observation/hold requests rather than waiting at an impossible frequency.
behavior.capture_geometry: The same VFO interval calculation drives tuning reconciliation and scan validation: exact effective clock, RF-decimator edge reserve, shared USB/LSB/DSB/CW nominal passband geometry, mode-profile width and logical frequency limits. File center and replay position stay fixed.
behavior.memory_profiles: Preview each requested mode profile before validating. Apply the selected bookmark mode before tuning, preventing the previous wider mode from clamping an otherwise available edge channel.
behavior.range_grid: Only positions on the requested scan grid count. Auto resolution and validation share exact mode boundaries; first/last grid positions in each mode interval suffice without iterating an unbounded frequency range.
behavior.transitions: Revalidate on every active replay scan tick and before applying pending tuning, including source, sample-rate, RF-decimation, center, mode and bandwidth changes.
behavior.freshness: Existing acknowledged-tuning, settle, complete-observation, dwell, sequence and stale-input guards remain active. Fixed-file rejection is restricted to Replay; retunable sources can still retune their capture center.

regressions.fractional_rate: 192003 / 8 = 24000.375 S/s; integer VFO limits retain complete passbands without rounding outside coverage.
regressions.unavailable_full_band: RAW full-capture nominal width cannot fit in the reserved usable band and is rejected for scanning; RAW playback remains a separate open finding.
cases: In-span exact edges, one Hz beyond either edge, and both endpoints outside fixed capture.
Reject a bookmark list containing an unavailable WFM channel although its NFM geometry would fit; allow complete USB/LSB edge passbands after switching from WFM.
Retunable idle source to replay; subsequent sample-rate/RF-decimation, configured bandwidth and capture-center changes; no hardware opened.
Sparse scan grid whose stop value is not visited; grid that crosses an Auto-mode boundary; every exact Auto boundary resolves consistently.
No tuning, stream-generation or replay-position change on rejected scan; cached high-level frames cannot generate hits after rejection.
All 26 scanner tests, 23 radio UI tests and 31 mode tests pass, including the original acknowledgment/settle/dwell/stale-frame guards.

development_notes: Initial focused attempt passed four tests and failed a transition fixture whose default 100 kHz scan step never reached its 50 kHz stop value. Validation correctly accepted that single-channel grid. Set the intended 25 kHz step so the out-of-span channel is actually visited, then added bandwidth and capture-center transition cases. All five focused tests pass; no production gate or threshold was weakened.
limits: Verification was serialized within a cgroup quota of 20000 microseconds per 100000 microseconds (20% of one CPU), nice 19, one Cargo build job and one test thread. Captured CPU policy/stats confirm the quota.
Only affected modules, GUI all-target Clippy, GUI default build, formatting and AST refresh were run. The CPU-heavy full workspace suite remains off following the user request.
